rounds.method_summary:
The operator profile justified one new experiment: splitting the image MLP by CFG batch. Real Dev passed with zero error, but latency worsened to **2,503.4 ms**, yielding **64.797% reduction**.

Preserved the attempt and feedback, updated [research-notes.md](<candidate-workspace>/research-notes.md) and [research-exhausted.json](<candidate-workspace>/research-exhausted.json), and restored experiment 41 to `method.py` and regenerated `program.json`.

Best remains **72.874% reduction**, **27.66 GiB** peak allocation.
